venmo_password = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_access = apis.venmo.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=venmo_password)
venmo_access_token = venmo_access['access_token']
print('logged_in', bool(venmo_access_token))
# Stacy email from phone contacts
stacy_phone_contacts = [c for c in globals().get('contacts', []) if c['first_name']=='Stacy']
print('stacy_phone_contacts', len(stacy_phone_contacts))
print(stacy_phone_contacts[0])
stacy_email = stacy_phone_contacts[0]['email']
print('stacy_email', stacy_email)
# Search venmo users by email; loop pagination
users=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    res = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_access_token, query=stacy_email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    users.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
print('total_users_found', len(users))
print(users[:10])
# Find exact match
exact=[u for u in users if u.get('email')==stacy_email]
print('exact_matches', len(exact))
print(exact)

create_res = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(user_email='st-maldonado@gmail.com', amount=13, access_token=venmo_access_token, description="For yesterday's meal", private=False)
print(create_res)

# Verify the created Venmo payment request
page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_reqs=[]
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_reqs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total_sent_payment_requests', len(all_reqs))
# Find our request
match = [r for r in all_reqs if r.get('payment_request_id')==6097]
print('match_count', len(match))
print('match', match)
